title: Husain ki khatir
body:
Husain ki khatir
Husain husain..(8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hui hai khalq ye duniya, HUSSAIN KI KHATIR..
Imam-e-Asr hai zinda
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR..
Hui hai khalq ye duniya, HUSSAIN KI KHATIR..
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Kaha rasul se rab ne na sar uthana abhi, Tumhari pusht pe baitha hua hai ibne Ali, Badhado aaj ye sajda...
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Qalam uthaya tha taamire Karbala ke liye, Wagarna jung thi kya ibne murtaza ke liye, Hasan ne zapt kiya tha...
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Kaha wo noor sarapa, kaha makaan mera, Sharaf ye farshe aza se mujhe naseeb hua, Mere ghar aa gayi Zehra...
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
<<DIVIDER>>
4)Yahi daleel hai ek-dusre se ulfat ki, Rizae rab ke liye kijiye azadari
Khuda ko kijiye sajda..
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
5)Mubahile ka asar Karbala me dekh liya, Wahab ki maa tujhe pohche salaam qaim ka, Khuda ko de diya beta..
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
6)Sila Hussain ki maadar se usko aisa mila, Har ek shaheed ye markad me kar raha hai dua, Ke maut aae dobara...
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
7)Hai isliye bhi zaruri juloos me jaana, Shumaar karte hai Abbas roze Aashura, Ke gharse kaun hai nikla...
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
8)Khuda ka shukr Takallum naseeb waala hu, Mai apna maksade takhleek yaad rakhta hu, Hai saans-saans meri Ya...
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KI KHATIR
author: Mir Hassan Mir
